name: Product and variant setup planner
why: Builds product types, a variant table and a fill-in checklist, the starting point for the catalogue structure skill.

name: Monthly catalogue clean-up keeper
why: Finds missing costs, clashing SKUs and hidden products each month, as part of keeping the catalogue tidy.

name: Merchant Center feed health checker
why: Ranks Merchant Center problems by lost sales, the same first step as the product feed fix skill.

name: Merchant Center suspension checker
why: For account-level warnings and suspensions, which this kit says to stop and escalate.

name: Shopping feed audit coding prompt
why: A coding brief for a script that checks a Shopping feed for missing fields and gaps at scale.

name: Shopping feed title writer
why: Writes search-led feed titles from products and converting search terms, to pair with the title patterns here.

name: Retail markdown stock reconciler
why: Checks a marked-down batch: units sold and left, contribution and cash recovered against cost.

name: Discount and price change checker
why: Finds the deepest discount the margin allows before a sale or price change is approved.

name: Order threshold planner
why: Sets free delivery and bundle thresholds at real order peaks, as in the bundles and order value skill.

name: Raise order value with bundles and add-ons you can check
why: A full run from sales export to threshold, bundles and an after-sale offer that keeps profit.

name: Bundle and quantity-break builder
why: Builds bundle tiers and price lines for a hero product, with cost and price inputs.

name: Cart and checkout upsell planner
why: Ranks cart and checkout add-ons by profit per order, one offer per slot.

name: Etsy shop opening planner
why: Plans an Etsy shop's listings, photos, price check and launch, for digital product sellers starting out.
